status.summary: Ranked #5 at lightweight after choking out Benoit Saint Denis in 52 seconds at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026). That win came six months after his first UFC loss, a five-round decision to Justin Gaethje for the interim title at UFC 324 (Jan 24, 2026). No fight is booked: he had stem-cell injections in his left hand in October 2026 and is aiming to return in early 2027. Ilia Topuria has named him as the opponent he wants in April 2027.

style.summary: A heavy-handed volume puncher who walks forward and brawls, and the most dangerous submission threat in any scramble. Most of his UFC finishes are chokes, from the back, from guard and now from the front headlock. He gets hit and taken down more than a top-five fighter should, but he has never been stopped in the UFC and he finished a five-round fight with Gaethje still throwing.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1. The engine's target split should come from fighters.json, where recency-weighted landed shares are head 0.60 / body 0.20 / leg 0.19 and attempt shares are head 0.75 / body 0.14 / leg 0.11. He kicks the legs more than most lightweights (leg strikes are 19-21% of his landed strikes vs a median of about 15%). His body share (18-20%) is near or slightly below the median (about 22%), though he landed 48 body strikes vs Gaethje (raw bout stats). No source splits body kicks from body punches, so the body group is spread evenly. Leg kicks are split evenly; recaps say he opened with low kicks vs Green and Chandler but do not say whether they were calf or inside kicks. Knee and elbow are raised for the Chandler fight, where a knee opened the cut and elbows from mount ended it (CBS, UFC Stats). Spinning is 0. The head group is a judgment for a jab-and-cross volume boxer, not a published breakdown.

engine_notes.note: Never stopped in the UFC (0 KO/TKO or submission losses in 9 bouts) despite absorbing 2 knockdowns from Gaethje; his chin and recovery should be treated as above average.
Five-round pace (2 fights, small sample): significant-strike rate by round relative to round 1 is 1.00 / 1.06 / 1.65 / 1.32 / 0.79, so output peaks in rounds 3-4 and dips in round 5.

Submission threat in scrambles: 1.36 attempts per 15 min career (lightweight median about 0.28); his last two submissions came from bottom guard (triangle) and off a sprawl (D'Arce), so a failed shot by his opponent is a live finishing chance for him.
Opponents control him: 24-27% opponent control time vs 19-21% his own; wrestlers can bank rounds on him if they avoid his chokes.
